items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: When Tommy came back to Washington, I got Tommy and Chester, and we formed this trio.

ctx.x: So I quit the band and I came back to Washington. That was in September 1945. I came to Washington and formed a little trio. Incidentally, Tommy Potter left the band shortly after I did. When they came back, I formed this trio... Nat King Cole was at his peak then as far as the trio situation was concerned, and I liked the idea that the clubs were all using trios. There was a very good guitar player in Washington then whose name was Chester Brown. Chester and I had played together earlier in the Tommy Miles band.…

Anyway, I was very fortunate... When Tommy came back to Washington, I got Tommy and Chester, and we formed this trio. While I was forming the trio, one day I happened to get a call from Sarah Vaughan. She just called me to say hello. She says, "What are you doing?" I said, "I'm putting a trio together."
